faq_heading: Questions B2B teams ask about AI SEO agents

faqs.q: What is an AI SEO agent?
faqs.a: It is software that runs your blog for you. It picks topics your buyers search for, writes each post, makes the images and publishes it on your site. With Clara AI, our team checks the work and you get a weekly report.

faqs.q: Will AI-written posts hurt my Google rankings?
faqs.a: Google judges whether content is helpful to people, not how it was produced. Posts that answer real buyer questions clearly, with accurate facts and a person checking them, are what you want. Thin posts written only to game rankings tend to do poorly whoever writes them.

faqs.q: How long does an AI SEO agent take to show results?
faqs.a: New posts usually get indexed and start earning impressions in the first weeks, and clicks build as more posts go live. On claraai.tech, organic sessions rose 28% from 10–25 Oct 2026 compared with 24 Sep–9 Oct 2026, after our agent started publishing on 10 Oct.

faqs.q: Does an AI SEO agent help my business show up in ChatGPT and other AI assistants?
faqs.a: It can. AI assistants tend to quote pages that rank well and give clear, direct answers. Posts that answer the question at the top, use question headings and include a short FAQ are easier for them to quote.

faqs.q: Do I approve what gets published?
faqs.a: Yes. You approve the topic plan and the image style before posts start, and our team checks each post. After that the agent publishes daily so the blog never goes quiet.

faqs.q: Who is an AI SEO agent not right for?
faqs.a: It is not right for one-off social media posting, low-value consumer products, or teams with no budget for a paid monthly service. It is built for B2B companies whose buyers research online before they buy.
